## 📥 Installation

### Update from Previous Version

```bash
# Backup current version
npm run export

# Update to new version
npm install

# Verify installation
npm run test
```

### Fresh Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xenon231tech/xenon-airdop-task-tracker.git
cd xenon-airdop-task-tracker
npm install
npm run dev
```
